feedbacks_content_valid.name: feedbacks_content_valid
feedbacks_content_valid.value: ("feedbacks"."kind" = 'text' AND length(trim("feedbacks"."body")) > 0 AND "feedbacks"."voice_asset_id" IS NULL) OR ("feedbacks"."kind" = 'voice' AND "feedbacks"."body" IS NULL AND "feedbacks"."voice_asset_id" IS NOT NULL)

invitations_open_student_unique.name: invitations_open_student_unique
invitations_open_student_unique.where: "invitations"."student_id" IS NOT NULL AND "invitations"."consumed_at" IS NULL AND "invitations"."revoked_at" IS NULL

invitations_open_assistant_unique.name: invitations_open_assistant_unique
invitations_open_assistant_unique.where: "invitations"."assistant_id" IS NOT NULL AND "invitations"."consumed_at" IS NULL AND "invitations"."revoked_at" IS NULL
